gap: The projects room (kacha) is orange-soaked: its shadows sit at red-brown (about rgb 49,28,20 with the blue channel near zero) with no cool sky fill, so it breaks from the wall chapters (contact shadows read lavender, about 75,59,64) and the grade is not one continuous look; pull the room's shadows toward a cool, slightly blue-neutral brown and trim its overall orange.
notes: hello/taped match the bar closely: warm lit plaster, soft window shadows, fine grain, natural skin. Scrapbook is close but hazy and low-contrast, and the shadow band is grey-brown with little coolness. Contact shadows lean noticeably violet, more than the bar, so wall and contact disagree in the other direction. Room bloom sits correctly on the window and floor patches with no full-frame haze; dust motes are a bit large and bright. Room blacks are deep and not crushed. No visible banding. No console errors or failed chapters.
